review_fixes: Derived slot paths are checked before lock creation so an ancestor root cannot place a slot inside a protected bundle.
Persisted request identity excludes the session-local configuration generation; a restart regression covers refreshed routing.
Runtime start allocates control metadata before activation, matching the staged restore pattern.
limitations: Synchronous JSON save and staged runtime; no hitch-free/asynchronous or large-game performance claim.
Fixed entity set and exact content/backend/module/schema; no general migrations or spawn/despawn persistence.
No dedicated human save window, typed C# gameplay save commands, autosave scheduler or platform/cloud storage provider.
No power-loss or network/cloud filesystem guarantee. Injected boundaries use exceptions and real child-process exits.
Checksums detect corruption, not authenticity; trusted module constructors/statics remain outside transaction isolation.
Physics solver caches and audio DSP history rebuild; future contact trajectories need not be bit-identical.
Desktop qualification uses C ABI and IPC without GPU, HWNDs, physical input or GUI screenshots.
The installed editor package remains its separately qualified checkpoint; these service changes are source/build artifacts.
